rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides direct integration with DevCycle's feature flag management platform, enabling AI assistants to create, manage, and analyze feature flags across projects and environments. Built as a hosted service with OAuth authentication, it offers comprehensive tools for feature management, variable configuration, self-targeting overrides, usage analytics, and SDK installation guidance across six organized categories. The implementation supports multiple AI clients including Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, and Windsurf through both SSE and HTTP streaming protocols, making it valuable for development teams who want AI-assisted feature flag workflows, A/B testing management, and deployment control without switching between tools.
